title: Other laws not affected.
bodyText: Nothing contained in sections 634-30 and 634-31 shall be construed to amend or repeal chapter 425 or 432, article 1, or section 634-3.
bodyHtml: §634-32  Other laws not affected.  Nothing contained in sections 634-30 and 634-31 shall be construed to amend or repeal chapter 425 or 432, article 1, or section 634-3. [L Sp 1949, c 4, §3; RL 1955, §230-41; HRS §634-68; ren HRS §634-32; am L 2016, c 55, §28]
